_doc: Scenario playbooks. Placeholders: {business} {product} {object} {setting}. Each leg is ONE continuous camera move of 4-8 s; legs chain (next leg starts from the last frame of the previous one). `sees` is what the visitor sees at the end of the leg. `overlay` is the copy beat that scrolls over that part.

furniture-interior.title: Furniture, interiors, home
furniture-interior.journey: approach from outside -> through the glass -> across the room -> down to the material
furniture-interior.setting: a calm modern home at blue-hour dusk, warm interior light

legs.camera: slow forward dolly across the lawn toward the glass wall
legs.overlay: A quiet house, seen from outside.

legs.camera: continue forward, pass through the glass into the room
continue forward and slightly lower toward {object}
legs.overlay: Made to the size of your home.

legs.camera: continue forward and lower along the side of {object}
legs.sees: base, edge and upholstery up close

legs.camera: keep pushing until the fabric and the arm fill the frame
legs.overlay: Design finds its meaning in detail.

furniture-interior.palette: warm walnut, taupe, brass accent on deep forest or charcoal
furniture-interior.type: elegant serif display + small tracked uppercase labels
furniture-interior.tone: quiet, assured, precise; no exclamation marks
risks: mirrored left/right layout of the product across references
model rotating the sofa instead of moving the camera
repetitive stripes tear under optical flow

headline: Made To The Size
Of Your Home
layers.paragraph: {product} is made to order, in the fabric and size you choose.
layers.bold: Every piece is built for one home.
layers.big: Every {business} piece is designed and built for one home. We choose the fabric, the wood and the proportion with you, down to the last stitch.

real-estate-architecture.title: Real estate, architecture, construction
real-estate-architecture.journey: arrive -> enter -> walk the main space -> out to the view
real-estate-architecture.setting: a finished residence at golden hour

legs.camera: forward glide along the approach toward the entrance
continue forward through the door into the hall
legs.overlay: Space with a point of view.

legs.camera: continue forward through the living area
legs.sees: the open plan and the garden beyond

legs.camera: continue and drift toward the window wall
continue through the glass out to the terrace
legs.overlay: A view worth coming home to.

real-estate-architecture.palette: stone, oak, warm white, one accent colour from the site
real-estate-architecture.type: grotesk or serif display, wide tracking labels
risks: geometry warping on long straight lines

headline: Spaces That Feel
Like Home
layers.paragraph: {business} designs and builds residences with one idea: light first.
layers.bold: Every plan starts from the view.
layers.big: {business} designs, builds and finishes {product} with the same patience: plan, material, light, then the last detail.

restaurant-cafe.title: Restaurants, cafes, bakeries
restaurant-cafe.journey: street -> door -> counter -> the dish / the cup
restaurant-cafe.setting: a warm, intimate dining room in the evening

legs.camera: slow forward dolly toward the lit entrance
continue through the door along the room
continue and lower toward the pass / counter
continue forward and down toward {object}
legs.overlay: The dish we are known for.

legs.camera: keep pushing until texture fills the frame

restaurant-cafe.palette: warm amber, deep brown, cream, one ingredient colour
restaurant-cafe.type: soft serif display + small caps labels

headline: Cooked Slowly,
Served Warm
layers.paragraph: {business} cooks {product} the long way, on purpose.
layers.big: At {business} everything is made in house, every day: the dough, the broth, the sauce, and the time it takes.

hotel-travel.title: Hotels, villas, travel
hotel-travel.journey: horizon -> arrival path -> lobby -> room -> balcony view
hotel-travel.setting: a boutique property in soft morning light

legs.camera: slow forward glide over water / landscape toward the property
continue along the path to the entrance
continue through the entrance
continue into {object}
continue through the balcony doors

hotel-travel.palette: sand, sea blue, white linen, brass

headline: A Place To
Arrive Slowly
layers.paragraph: {business} is a small property for people who prefer quiet.
layers.bold: Rooms with a view, time with no schedule.
layers.big: {business} is built around slowness: the light in the morning, the sound of the water, and a room that asks nothing of you.

jewelry-watch.title: Jewelry, watches, luxury objects
jewelry-watch.journey: macro approach -> light catching the surface -> engraving/setting -> the whole piece
jewelry-watch.setting: a dark studio with a single soft key light

legs.camera: slow macro push toward {object} out of darkness
continue forward along the surface
continue and drift toward the stone / detail
pull the focus back as the camera keeps moving
continue to a soft hold on the signature angle

jewelry-watch.type: high-contrast serif display, small tracked labels
risks: tiny text engravings are rendered wrongly (avoid text)

headline: Made To Be
Worn For Years
layers.bold: Each piece is finished by hand.
layers.big: Every {business} piece starts as a drawing and ends as an object you will not take off: weight, polish and proportion, decided together.

beauty-perfume-skincare.title: Beauty, perfume, skincare
beauty-perfume-skincare.setting: a minimal studio, pale surface, soft diffused light

legs.camera: slow forward move into a pool of light / liquid
continue forward as {object} rises into frame
continue and drift toward the cap / label side
continue to a wider soft composition
gentle hold with a very slow push

beauty-perfume-skincare.palette: milk white, pale pink or sage, soft shadow
beauty-perfume-skincare.type: light serif or humanist sans, generous spacing
risks: label text is rendered wrongly (put the brand in HTML, not in the image)

headline: Made Gently,
Worn Daily
layers.paragraph: {business} makes {product} with few ingredients and long patience.
layers.big: {business} formulates in small batches. Every {product} is tested for how it feels first, then for what it does.

fashion.title: Fashion, apparel, textiles
fashion.journey: fabric close-up -> movement -> garment form -> detail
fashion.setting: a bright, minimal studio; fabric in motion (no faces)

legs.camera: slow forward move along moving fabric
continue as the fabric settles into a shape
continue to reveal {object} on a form
continue toward the seam / collar
slow push to a detail hold

headline: Cut To Move,
Made To Last
layers.big: {business} designs a few pieces each season and makes them well: the cloth chosen first, the cut second, the finish last.

automotive.title: Automotive, motorcycles, mobility
automotive.journey: approach in the open -> the lines -> the wheel/light -> the cabin
automotive.setting: an empty road or studio at dusk with reflective floor

legs.camera: low forward glide toward {object}
continue along the flank
continue and lower toward the wheel / light
continue up and in through the window
slow push to the dashboard / key detail

automotive.palette: gunmetal, deep blue or red accent, cool light
risks: license plates and badges are rendered wrongly

headline: Built Around
The Drive
layers.big: {business} tunes every {product} by hand: the line of the body, the weight of the steering, the sound under load.

tech-saas-app.title: Software, SaaS, apps, AI
tech-saas-app.setting: an abstract dark space of light and glass

legs.camera: forward move through drifting points of light
continue as the points form lines and a grid
continue toward a floating glass panel
continue through the panel along connected elements
slow push to a calm, bright result state

tech-saas-app.palette: near-black, electric blue or violet, white
risks: readable UI text must be HTML overlay, never generated

headline: Less Noise,
More Work Done
layers.big: {business} connects the tools you already use, removes the duplicate steps and leaves one clear place to work.

clinic-dental-wellness.title: Clinics, dental, wellness, spas
clinic-dental-wellness.journey: water/light -> calm surface -> clean space -> warm finish
clinic-dental-wellness.setting: a bright, calm, minimal treatment space

legs.camera: slow forward move toward a single water droplet
continue as the droplet meets still water
continue and open into {object}
legs.overlay: A calm place to be treated.

legs.camera: continue toward soft equipment and plants
slow push as warm light spreads

clinic-dental-wellness.palette: aqua, white, soft teal, warm light at the end
clinic-dental-wellness.tone: reassuring, plain words, no medical claims

headline: Care, Without
The Waiting Room
layers.big: {business} is designed around how you feel before, during and after your visit. Unhurried time, clear answers and a space that is easy to be in.

food-beverage-packaging.title: Food, beverage, packaged products
food-beverage-packaging.setting: a dark, warm studio with steam, light rays and ingredient colour

legs.camera: slow forward move through the raw ingredient
legs.sees: leaves, grains or fruit in light

legs.camera: continue as the ingredient becomes the product
continue as {object} comes into focus
continue toward the pour / bite
slow push to a detail hold

food-beverage-packaging.palette: deep black or brown, one rich ingredient colour, gold highlight
risks: label text rendered wrongly (add the brand in HTML)

headline: From The Source,
To Your Table
layers.big: {business} works with the same growers every season. The ingredient decides the product, and the product decides the pace.

fitness-sport.title: Fitness, sport, performance
fitness-sport.journey: dust and light -> frozen movement -> impact -> form
fitness-sport.setting: a dark training hall with hard side light

legs.camera: forward move through chalk dust in a shaft of light
continue toward {object}
continue as dust and light burst
continue to a controlled close
slow push to a hero detail

fitness-sport.palette: black, ember red or amber, white

headline: Built One Rep
At A Time
layers.big: {business} is run by people who train. We build programs that start with how you move and end with what you can lift.

education-course.title: Education, courses, academies
education-course.journey: spark -> lines of thought -> structure -> mastery

legs.camera: forward move toward a small point of light
continue as lines grow from the point
continue through a growing structure
continue toward a desk with tools
slow push to a bright result

headline: Learn It Once,
Use It For Good
layers.big: {business} is built for people who want the skill, not the certificate: clear lessons, real projects and someone who answers.

legal-finance-consulting.title: Legal, finance, consulting, B2B services
legal-finance-consulting.setting: an abstract architectural interior in stone and glass

legs.camera: slow forward move along a stone / paper surface
continue past columns / pillars
continue through a glass partition
continue toward {object} in a calm room
slow push as light settles

headline: Clear Advice,
Calmly Given
layers.big: {business} works in plain language: what the options are, what they cost, and what we would do in your place.

craft-workshop-manufacturing.title: Craft, workshops, manufacturing, makers
craft-workshop-manufacturing.journey: raw material -> tool -> making -> finished piece
craft-workshop-manufacturing.setting: a warm workshop with natural light and wood dust in the air

legs.camera: slow forward move along raw material
continue toward the tools on the bench
continue as the work takes shape (no hands in frame)
continue to the finished surface
slow push to {object}

craft-workshop-manufacturing.palette: oak, leather brown, brass, dusty light

headline: Made Slowly,
Made To Keep
layers.big: {business} chooses the material first and the method second. Every {product} is made once, for one person.

generic.title: Any other business (default)
generic.journey: wide establishing -> approach -> reveal the subject -> close on the detail

legs.camera: slow forward dolly toward the subject's world
legs.sees: the setting with {object} in the distance

legs.camera: continue forward, closer
continue and drift to the best angle
continue lower / closer along the surface
slow push to a hero close-up

generic.palette: choose from the brand; dark base with one warm accent works almost everywhere
generic.type: one serif display + small tracked uppercase labels

headline: Made With Care,
Made For You
layers.big: Say what makes {business} different in two plain sentences, then end on the detail the visitor can picture.
